name: 14_open_coffee_machine
title: Brewing Coffee with Dual Arms
summary: A dual-arm robot opens a coffee machine, inserts a capsule, retrieves a cup from the sink area, and prepares the machine.
robot: two robotic arms with articulated black grippers
setting: a kitchen countertop with a coffee machine, capsule box, and adjacent sink

source.original_prompt: Open the lid of the capsule coffee machine with both hands

segments.instruction: Stabilize the coffee machine with the left gripper while the right gripper grasps the top lever handle.
Pull the lever all the way up and backward with the right gripper to open the capsule slot, keeping the camera focused on the machine.
Release the lever and use the right gripper to pick up a blue capsule from the box on the counter.
Drop the capsule into the open chamber and push the lever all the way down to close the machine.
segments.memory_event: hide: capsule hidden inside the closed coffee machine

segments.instruction: Turn the head camera to the right to look at the sink and countertop area.
segments.memory_event: hide: coffee machine and capsule tray go out of view

segments.instruction: Reach with the right gripper to grasp the small mug resting beside the sink basin.
Turn the head camera back toward the coffee machine and place the mug onto the machine's drip tray.
segments.memory_event: return: coffee machine and capsule box reappear in their previous states and positions

segments.instruction: Lift the top lever of the coffee machine back up with the right gripper.
segments.memory_event: return: the capsule inserted earlier is visible inside the chamber
